duotone-shadow.canonical: safelight table stop 1: R 0.17, G 0.02, B 0.05

duotone-mid.canonical: safelight table stop 2: R 0.82, G 0.07, B 0.17

duotone-highlight.canonical: safelight table stop 3: R 1, G 0.92, B 0.90

display.purpose: The name, edge to edge along the bottom of the hero; uppercase. 21.2vw below 800px.

marquee.purpose: A project name running behind or around its screens. 18vw on phones.

email.purpose: The contact address, fitted to the content width. rail-room is 0 below 800px.

lead.purpose: The statement paragraph, revealed word by word on scroll.

title.purpose: Project rows; the pinned project title shares this voice.

label-data.purpose: Table headers, row status and figure numbers.

label-index.purpose: Frame numbers above each contact-sheet entry.

shadows.name: tab-lift
shadows.purpose: filter on the top bar; follows the tab silhouette and separates the white tab from the lit-room ground.

shadows.name: ledger-trace
shadows.purpose: Not elevation: redraws a pointed ledger row's hairlines in full ink.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Movement in pointer states and the entrance.

motion.name: ease-drawer
motion.purpose: The nav mark sliding between items, 260ms.

motion.name: scroll-smoothing
motion.value: cur += (scrollY - cur) * (1 - exp(-dt * 14)); dt capped at .05s; snaps within .4px
motion.purpose: The one smoothed value that drives every scrubbed effect.

motion.name: scrub-ease
motion.purpose: Position easing for scrubbed movement.

motion.name: plate-square-up
motion.value: t = inOut((p - .04 - i * .02) / .62); rotate to 0; scale to 20vw width (44vw on phones)
motion.purpose: p is hero pin progress, i the plate index.

motion.name: plate-develop
motion.purpose: Hero plates resolve from duotone to true colour.

motion.name: screen-part
motion.value: t = inOut(p / .6); translateX -78% to -106% and -22% to 6%; rotate +-4deg to 0; scale .62 (.8 on phones) to 1
motion.purpose: App screens grow and part; p is project pin progress.

motion.name: screen-develop
motion.purpose: App screens resolve to true colour.

motion.name: marquee-oppose
motion.value: translateX 2% to -48% and -48% to 2%, linear in p
motion.purpose: Two name rows run in opposite directions.

motion.name: copy-reveal
motion.value: opacity = clamp((p - .55) / .16), start .25 on phones; translateY 16px to 0
motion.purpose: Project copy arrives after the screens settle.

motion.name: word-reveal
motion.value: word opacity .2 to 1, stepped by word index across the block's scroll travel
motion.purpose: The statement paragraph reads in as it is scrolled.

motion.name: print-wash
motion.purpose: Only the print facing the viewer is fully developed.

motion.name: logo-helix
motion.value: theta = i * 30deg - wind; translate3d(R sin theta, (at - i) * rise, R cos theta) rotateY(theta); R = 2.3 size, rise = .42 size, perspective 1500px
motion.purpose: Scroll, or circles drawn with a real pointer, wind the logo prints round a helix and turn the tick dial behind it; static grid with reduced motion.

motion.name: contact-unclip
motion.purpose: The crimson field opens to full bleed.

motion.name: duration-state
motion.purpose: Colour and press states; pressed scale .97.

motion.name: duration-pointer
motion.purpose: Duo and wash 200ms, arrows 200ms, row icon 220ms, print 240ms, row wipe 280ms, plate scale and theme icon 300ms.

motion.name: name-trail
motion.purpose: Each hero letter takes crimson under the pointer, leaving a trail.

motion.name: entrance
motion.value: tab 560ms translateY(-88px) to 0 with strip 640ms scaleX 0 to 1 from the centre, no delay; name 1000ms opacity and translate 14%; plate 900ms, delay 120ms, opacity, rotate and 6vh rise; intro and action 500ms opacity, delay 500ms; all ease-out
motion.purpose: Once on first paint, only with scrollY under 10.

motion.name: theme-crossfade
motion.purpose: Softens the room-lights flip where supported; instant otherwise.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No pinning, duotone, wash, smoothing, entrance or larger pointer movement (plate scale, print rise, logo scale, row shift); everything in place in true colour.

grain.technique: fixed SVG feTurbulence fractalNoise, baseFrequency .85, numOctaves 2, saturate 0, 220px tile

narrative.overview:
The page is a near-black room lit by one crimson safelight. Images arrive as crimson duotone plates and resolve to true colour as the visitor scrolls, the way a print comes up in the tray. Scroll position, smoothed once, is the only clock for that change, so the page reads as one continuous development rather than a sequence of separate animations.

Everything else stays out of the way of that event. Off-white ink sets tight, heavy grotesk type at very large sizes, Geist Mono carries numbering and data, surfaces are flat and sharp-cornered, and film grain sits over the whole frame. Density swings on purpose: pinned stages hold a single idea at full viewport height, while the rows and ledgers below them are open, hairline-ruled and text-only.

The theme toggle turns the room lights on. Ground and ink swap, the duotone and the wash disappear, and every plate shows in full colour. Crimson and the white tab do not change between rooms.
keyCharacteristics: One crimson, reserved for what is live or actionable.
Images develop from duotone to true colour on one scroll timeline.
Sharp-cornered plates and prints with no resting shadow.
A white tab with flared shoulders hanging from a thin top bar.
Tight heavy grotesk display over small mono data labels.
A fixed frame number on a vertical edge rail.
Film grain over the entire page.

rules.name: The Live Crimson Rule
rules.body: Crimson marks something developing, current, pointed at or actionable. Nothing else gets it, and no second accent exists.

rules.name: The Room Lights Rule
rules.body: The theme switches ground, ink, dim, line, ghost and grain (dark .06, light .04). It never changes crimson or the white tab, and in the lit room the duotone and wash layers are removed entirely.

rules.name: The True Colour Default Rule
rules.body: True colour is the base state. The duotone layer is a clone added by script, so without script, under reduced motion or in the lit room, plates are simply the photograph.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: The grotesk speaks and the mono counts. Mono carries numbering, table headers, status and nav, and never a sentence.

rules.name: The Frame Number Rule
rules.body: A section's number lives on the edge rail, in the form `02 / 05`. Mono indexes may sit with items in a numbered series (a figure, a contact-sheet frame), but section headings never get a label above them.

rules.name: The One Timeline Rule
rules.body: New scroll effects are added to the one smoothed render loop as a function of scroll position. They never get their own listener, library or trigger.

rules.name: The Hold Still Rule
rules.body: Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` pinning, duotone, wash, entrance, smoothing and the larger pointer movements (plate scale, print rise, logo scale, row shift) all go away. Stages stop pinning and every image sits in place in true colour.

rules.name: The Real Pointer Rule
rules.body: Hover states exist only inside `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`. Project rows mirror their hover state on `:focus-visible`, so keyboard users get the same wipe.

rules.name: The Flat Plate Rule
rules.body: Plates, prints, buttons and rows carry no resting or hover shadow. A pointed plate scales to 1.03 and comes forward in z-order instead.

rules.name: The Sharp Plate Rule
rules.body: Anything that holds an image or an action outside the nav is square-cornered. Curves belong to the nav tab.

dos: Do route every photograph and app screen through the two-layer plate so it starts in `safelight` duotone and ends in true colour.
Do add new scroll effects to the single smoothed render loop.
Do keep crimson (#d0142f) to live state and the contact action, so the Live Crimson Rule still holds at a glance.
Do swap ground and ink in the lit room, remove the duotone and wash layers, and keep the tab white.
Do give every new section a fixed frame number on the rail in `NN / NN` form.
Do set hairlines at 1px using the line colour.
Do keep text and rule blocks 18px clear of the rail beyond the gutter.
Do provide the reduced-motion version of every new effect: in place, true colour, no pin.
Do gate hover behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)` and mirror essential row states on `:focus-visible`.
donts: Don't add a second accent or put crimson on anything that is not live or the contact action.

Don't bake duotone into a photograph or fake it with a blend; photographs and app screens take the `safelight` filter. The `multiply` wash belongs to logos, masked to each logo's shape; prints have no backing, so logos stand directly on the ground. The black Render mark inverts in the dark room.
Don't put a shadow on plates, prints, buttons or rows; the tab lift is the system's only drop shadow.
Don't round plates, prints, buttons, rows or fields; the tab's shoulders and pill states are the only curves.
Don't place a kicker or eyebrow above a section heading; the number lives on the rail.
Don't set sentences in mono or add a third typeface.
Don't trigger scroll effects on entering the viewport or give them separate timers; they scrub with position.
Don't treat placeholder rows or ledger cells as content; the component is the system, and its text comes from the owner.
